scripts.populate-data: NODE_ENV=development tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/validate-environment.ts && NODE_ENV=development pnpm run update-data -- --bookmarks --github --logos
scripts.prebuild: NODE_ENV=production tsx scripts/init-csp-hashes.ts && NODE_ENV=production tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/sync-blog-cover-images.ts
scripts.dev: tsx scripts/init-csp-hashes.ts && pnpm run cleanCache && NODE_ENV=development node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev --webpack
scripts.dev:update-data: NODE_ENV=development tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/validate-environment.ts && NODE_ENV=development pnpm run update-data
scripts.dev:with-data: tsx scripts/init-csp-hashes.ts && pnpm run populate-data && pnpm run cleanCache && NODE_ENV=development node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev --webpack
scripts.build: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; NODE_ENV=production tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/validate-environment.ts; SKIP_BUILD="${SKIP_BUILD_VALIDATIONS:-}"; if [ -z "$SKIP_BUILD" ]; then RAILWAY_SIGNAL="${RAILWAY_STATIC_URL:-}${RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN:-}${RAILWAY_PRIVATE_DOMAIN:-}${RAILWAY_PROJECT_NAME:-}${RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID:-}${RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME:-}${RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID:-}${RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME:-}${RAILWAY_SERVICE_ID:-}"; if [ -n "$RAILWAY_SIGNAL" ]; then SKIP_BUILD=1; else SKIP_BUILD=0; fi; fi; if [ "$SKIP_BUILD" != "1" ]; then pnpm run validate:build; else echo "Skipping validate:build (CI detected or SKIP_BUILD_VALIDATIONS=1)"; fi; BASELINE_BROWSER_MAPPING_IGNORE_OLD_DATA=true NODE_ENV=production node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build'
scripts.build:only: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; NODE_ENV=production tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/validate-environment.ts; pnpm run check:file-size; BASELINE_BROWSER_MAPPING_IGNORE_OLD_DATA=true NODE_ENV=production node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build'
scripts.build:full: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; NODE_ENV=production tsx --env-file-if-exists=.env scripts/validate-environment.ts; pnpm run validate:with-size; BASELINE_BROWSER_MAPPING_IGNORE_OLD_DATA=true NODE_ENV=production node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build'
scripts.docker:build: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; if docker buildx version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[docker:build] Using docker buildx (BuildKit)"; DOCKER_BUILDKIT=${DOCKER_BUILDKIT:-1} docker buildx build --platform=linux/amd64 --build-arg NODE_ENV=production --build-arg NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 --load -t williamcallahan-web:latest .; else echo "[docker:build] docker buildx not found; falling back to classic docker build"; DOCKER_BUILDKIT=${DOCKER_BUILDKIT:-0} docker build --build-arg NODE_ENV=production --build-arg NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 -t williamcallahan-web:latest .; fi'
scripts.docker:prefetch: docker run --platform=linux/amd64 -e NODE_ENV=production -e CONTAINER=true williamcallahan-scheduler:latest node --run update-data -- --bookmarks --github --logos
scripts.lint: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:checks
scripts.lint:checks: pnpm run lint:ox && pnpm run lint:es && pnpm run check:duplicate-types
scripts.lint:es:ci: eslint . --config config/eslint.config.ts --format stylish || (echo 'ESLint found issues but build continues (non-blocking)' && exit 0)
scripts.lint:ast-grep: ast-grep scan -c config/sgconfig.yml && echo 'No ast-grep violations found'
scripts.guard:runtime-json-s3-ops: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; if rg -n "(getObject|putObject|deleteFromS3|listS3Objects|readBinaryS3|writeBinaryS3)\\(\\s*[\"\x27]json/" src --glob "!src/lib/s3/**"; then echo "[Runtime JSON S3 Guard] Found forbidden json/* S3 object operations in src/. Use PostgreSQL-backed stores."; exit 1; fi'
scripts.check:file-size: bash -c 'fail=0; for f in $(find . -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" \) ! -name "*.d.ts" | grep -v "node_modules/" | grep -v ".next/"); do lines=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ $lines -gt 500 ]; then echo "[File Size Warning] $f exceeds $lines lines (limit: 500)"; fail=1; fi; done; if [ $fail -ne 0 ]; then echo "[File Size Check] Files exceed 500 lines — run pnpm run check:file-size for details"; fi; exit 0'
scripts.check:mdx: node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs/promises"; import path from "node:path"; import matter from "gray-matter"; import { compile } from "@mdx-js/mdx"; const dir = path.join(process.cwd(), "data/blog/posts"); const files = (await fs.readdir(dir)).filter((file) => file.endsWith(".mdx")).sort(); const failures = []; for (const file of files) { const source = await fs.readFile(path.join(dir, file), "utf8"); const { content } = matter(source); try { await compile(content); } catch (error) { failures.push({ file, message: error?.message ?? String(error) }); } } if (failures.length > 0) { for (const failure of failures) { console.error("FAIL " + failure.file + "\n" + failure.message + "\n"); } process.exit(1); } console.log("All " + files.length + " MDX posts compiled successfully.");'
scripts.validate: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:checks && pnpm run lint:ast-grep && pnpm run guard:runtime-json-s3-ops && pnpm run check:mdx && pnpm run type-check && tsx scripts/analyze-circular-deps.ts
scripts.validate:with-size: pnpm run check:file-size && pnpm run validate
scripts.validate:build: pnpm run lint:ox && pnpm run lint:es:ci && pnpm run check:duplicate-types && pnpm run guard:runtime-json-s3-ops && pnpm run check:mdx && pnpm run type-check && tsx scripts/analyze-circular-deps.ts && pnpm run check:file-size
scripts.validate:full: pnpm run lint && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run format:check
scripts.validate:ci: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint:checks && pnpm run guard:runtime-json-s3-ops && pnpm run type-check
scripts.verify: pnpm run validate:ci && pnpm run lint:ast-grep && pnpm run check:mdx && tsx scripts/analyze-circular-deps.ts && pnpm run check:file-size && pnpm run type-check:tests && pnpm run test:ci
scripts.verify:browser: pnpm run verify && pnpm run test:e2e:blog
scripts.test:e2e:blog: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; trap "node ./node_modules/next/dist/bin/next typegen" EXIT; playwright test --config config/playwright.config.ts'
scripts.//db-scripts: Scripts that connect to PostgreSQL are *.node.mjs files run directly by node.
